Product Features

  • Overall size: This coffee table has an ideal size of 100 x 50 x 38 cm. The warm white color with golden edges makes it stylish and elegant. The high-gloss design on and around the top panel looks like a glossy cover on the coffee table and underlines its refinement.
  • Unique shape: The unique shape, which is narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, breaks the conventional monotony and adds a touch of mobility and personality to the living space. It can be cleverly adapted to any style of living.
  • 2 Large Drawers: Equipped with 2 large drawers and built-in rebound switch. By pressing lightly, the drawers gently pop out. The operation is convenient and labor-saving and the small items can be easily stored in the living room.
  • Material: Made of chipboard, it is sturdy and durable. Although it is recommended to carry a weight of 30 kg, it is enough to accommodate coffee cups, books and other items for daily use.
  • The warm white colour exudes a soft atmosphere and ensures a warm living atmosphere. It is decorated with bright, gold-bordered decorations. It reveals a touch of light luxury in simplicity and immediately enhances the style of the living room.
  • High-gloss is easy to clean: The high-gloss surface is not only beautiful, but also easy to clean and maintain. If you accidentally spill coffee or tea stains, simply wipe them gently with a rag to make the coffee table clean as new again.
  • Large storage space: Two large drawers provide ample storage space, magazines, remote controls, snacks, etc. can be neatly stored, so that the living room says goodbye to the clutter and always remains tidy and tidy.
  • Practicality: From the unique design to the well-thought-out drawer arrangement to the high-quality chipboard material, every detail has been carefully worked out, highlighting the pursuit of quality of life.
  • Aesthetics: With its unique look and practical features, this warm white high-gloss coffee table with gold rim will become a beautiful landscape in the living room, bringing comfort and beauty to your home.

Descriptions

Description

This 100 x 50 x 38 cm coffee table is finished in stylish warm white with golden edges and the high-gloss design on the top and edges underlines its exclusivity. The unique shape, narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, fits all kinds of home decoration styles. The two large drawers with rebound switches are easy to use and offer space for various items. The chipboard material is sturdy and durable, and the recommended load capacity is 30kg to meet daily use. The high-gloss surface is easy to clean and coffee stains can be removed with a wipe. It is carefully crafted from the shape to the material details, combining beauty and functionality. It is an eye-catching and comfortable eye-catcher in the living room, ensuring that the living room is no longer cluttered and always remains tidy and tidy.
